chunks: From him, from his brother al-Ḥasan, from Zur‘ah, from Samā‘ah, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام about a man who touches his penis, or his private part, or lower than that, while he is standing performing salat (prayer): should he repeat his wudu (ablution)? He said: There is no harm in that; it is only a part of his body.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or problem

ai.seo_question: Does touching one’s private part invalidate wudu (ablution) during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that touching one’s private part during salat (prayer) does not invalidate wudu (ablution). The Imam عليه السلام explains this by stating that it is merely part of one’s own body, indicating no ritual impurity is caused by such contact.
